title: IT system update

messages.text: URGENT: Sceduled maintenance requires password verification.
Verify credentials now to maintain access:
Email and portal access may be briefly interrupted.
No action needed. Questions? Call ext. 4000.

explainPoints: Sender name format: 'IT-Support' with hyphen vs legitimate 'IT Support' with space.
Wrong number format: '1-877-659-2847' looks like a toll-free number. Real IT uses short code '55500'.
Typo in first message: 'Sceduled' should be 'Scheduled' - professional IT communications are proofread.
Suspicious link domain: nexatrust-itsupport.net is fake. Real IT never asks for credentials via text links.
Threatening tone: 'account locked!' creates panic. Legitimate IT messages are calm and helpful.
